correctness.rationale: The three sets of four-letter output factors starting at image residues 0,1,2 are pairwise disjoint; each block symbol is determined by any nonempty sampled subblock because 001 and 110 differ at all coordinates. Every factor of length >=4 consequently has the exact occurrence multiplicity of its shortest covering parent interval. A parent MUS of length >=3 lifts to [3a+2,3b-2) and repeats neither proper suffix nor prefix; conversely every unique output factor of length >=4 contains some lifted parent MUS, forcing all output MUSs to be lifts. The direct W2=001001110 base yields five unique length-three factors at starts 1,2,4,5,6. Every binary length-three word already occurs at least twice in W3, which is a prefix of later iterates, eliminating all shorter unique factors. Inductively lifting the five intervals scales m by three; no longer/other MUSs remain. Independent brute occurrence counting recovered two MUSs at n=1 and exactly five prescribed intervals at n=2,3,4; finite checks corroborate, not establish, the all-n induction.
